note: kind=automated runs here or in a lane's suite at fixture/installable level; kind=manual needs a person on a real Mac and stays OPEN until an evidence record exists; kind=decision needs Tom. Nothing here is end-to-end proof by itself.

acceptance.py package <built release> with the author's deny-terms file: allowlist only, no denied path, no secret/home path/proxy/thread id/personal term
acceptance.py starter <starter artifact>: clean commit, hashes match, privacy scan
acceptance.py install --home <installed HOME>: launchd label/abs paths/logs/KeepAlive/EXO_CONFIG, config keys, explicit models, no live-spike paths, no ~/.pi links, starter receipt, time zone set
acceptance.py isolation snapshot before and after every lane's tests; compare must pass
each lane's own temp-HOME tests (bundle: rollback refused, preflight; starter: conflict exit with zero writes; first-run: partial first start, no overwrite); reviewed, not rerun here

Tom picks page-first or BB thread view after the native layout spike shows both
Tom picks archive or private tag
never-used macOS account or VM with only BB installed: install command reports missing tools, shows full-access statement, finishes with version and vault path
decline the statement; then isolation-style listing shows no release, plist or plugin
real BB on the fresh account: one Exo entry, model picker has no test/clone Exo; screenshot
Exo entry asks for the owner's own provider sign-in; the first request goes to that provider directly, no proxy
send hello: reply on a drawn Home page; press a page button: reply arrives; uses the tester's own provider account
kill the owner during first start, start again: one entry, a reply, no second conversation
quit and reopen BB: same conversation
restart the Mac, sign in: owner service running, reply after the same conversation
kill the owner process: launchd restarts it, next send gets a reply

remove without deleting data, reopen BB, reinstall: earlier conversation returns
stop the owner and keep it from starting: check command names it, the fix and the log folder

type more than 1000 characters in a page textbox, press: Exo receives all of it; the reliability lane's regression test is automated support only
